write_up: Your resume points to executive assistant work: you now support three founders independently, after supporting the CEO at Parkway Logistics. A recruiter can see the people you supported and the work you handled, though a few lines leave them guessing about your part.

The leadership offsite line is a strong model: it names what you planned and how many people attended. One question sits between Parkway Logistics and your freelance work: the resume doesn't say what you were doing between June 2023 and February 2025.

Start by accounting for that time honestly, then add detail to the investor meetings and the work with department heads. You don't need to add a number to every line; a concrete example of what you handled will do.
